notes.title: 1.2 version
notes.content:
Version information:

[list]

[*] now when creating a task list, the sub items in it will change their length according to the content, so as to display more information!

[*] fix some characters and display garbled bugs in the software.

[*] fix the bug of music starting play when a work start.

[*] optimize the memory usage of the software. If you use a small memory computer, you should be able to run more smoothly now!

[/list]

Developer's words:

Hello！ The number of camp focus users has exceeded 13000. Thank you for your support! Version 1.2 fixes some important bugs and adds the function of adaptive task bar.Some more interesting new functions will be added in version 1.3. 

Looking forward to the next version:

In version 1.3 in late March, we will update a new scene, a new album, custom music library function ,and more.

notes.title: 1.1 version
notes.content:
Version information:
[list]
[*] Add a sound feedback for task finish. Now, when the task timing is over, there will be a LOFI style sound tip to let you know its finish.
[*] Fix the bug that achievement doesn't unlock.
[*] Other performance optimizations
[/list]
We will continue work on this project, to build a better experience.Have a good day!
